name: CustomerAccountCodeConflictReview
purpose: Bind shared-claim/reassignment acceptance to the exact reviewed Customer Account Code conflict without scanning an uncapped claimant set while SQLite's writer lock is held.

steps: validate and normalize complete code under UNICODE_MATCH_V1
load target Customer revision and its current active Account Code claim if any
for reassignment also load source Customer revision and prove its current claim for reviewed code
count every active claimant for normalized code and fetch only bounded claimant display page in immutable customer_org_id order

build canonical REVIEW_ACCOUNT_CODE_V1 document containing matching_profile_id, customer_reference_generation, normalized code key, proposed_action, target Customer ID/revision/current-code-key-or-null, optional source Customer ID/revision, and exact claimant_count
serialize fixed canonical field order as UTF-8 and compute SHA-256 review_snapshot_hash
return the hash plus bounded claimant display details/continuation
preview.binding_rule: customer_reference_generation changes transactionally whenever Customer Organization or Account Code claim state changes. It therefore conservatively invalidates the review when claimant membership/eligibility or other Customer reference state changes, without hashing an unbounded claimant list under the writer lock.
preview.rule: The hash is freshness/binding evidence, not authentication and not a substitute for authenticated session + anti-forgery + explicit operator confirmation.

commit_validation.transaction: inside same LLD-01 UnitOfWork before command_receipt/domain mutation
steps: load matching_profile_id and customer_reference_generation in O(1)
load target/source Customer rows and current Account Code claims with indexed point queries
count active claimants for normalized code using indexed COUNT without materializing claimant bodies
rebuild REVIEW_ACCOUNT_CODE_V1 from current generation/count/target/source state
constant-time compare recomputed SHA-256 text to supplied review_snapshot_hash
if different return REVIEW_CONTEXT_STALE with no receipt/mutation
run command-specific invariants (shared claim still has another claimant; reassignment source still owns code; targets remain active)
only then allow owning command to insert receipt and perform reviewed mutation
commit_validation.performance: Commit validation is O(1) point work plus an indexed COUNT for one normalized code; it never streams claimant detail under BEGIN IMMEDIATE. Detailed claimant identities remain read-only/paginated preview data outside writer lock.

generation_contract.maintenance: protected SQLite triggers increment the generation on Customer Organization INSERT/UPDATE and Account Code identifier INSERT/accepted active->superseded UPDATE
generation_contract.conservative_staleness: an unrelated Customer reference edit may invalidate an in-progress Account Code review; this is accepted because false-stale review is safer than accepting against changed reference state
generation_contract.overflow: generation uses nonnegative SQLite INTEGER; practical exhaustion is outside supported Beta lifetime, and overflow/constraint failure blocks the associated mutation atomically

audit: Successful reviewed correction records proposed_action, review_snapshot_hash, optional review_context_id, bounded normalized-code evidence under audit payload policy, and affected immutable Customer/identifier identities. It does not claim publisher authenticity or external-source truth.
security: review_context_id is correlation/provenance only and never sufficient authorization
stale UI or changed Customer/reference state fails before receipt/mutation
client cannot override server generation/count/target/source state used for hash recomputation
raw review narrative is not accepted; reason_category stays closed/bounded and source proposal evidence stays with its owning reconciliation domain
